scope: Installed production dependencies in package-lock.json; all are listed even when a particular export is removed by the renderer bundler. Metadata declarations do not override the preserved license texts.

license_files.source: Shared Apache-2.0 license from installed @univerjs/core@1.0.4 in the same upstream repository/version; verified against https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dream-num/univer/v1.0.4/LICENSE on 2026-10-15. The protocol package declares Apache-2.0 but omits a LICENSE file.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wooorm/franc/6.2.0/license (retrieved 2026-10-15; package README links to this repository license)
